adapter_policy: The A1/A2 sound chosen for each clip on the source timeline (camera channel, on/off, level in dB; A1 channel 1 and A2 channel 2 when a clip has none kept) as a table module of the project database intermediary (qnc-db-broker): clip_sound and the view public_clip_sound. A new segment or cover of the clip takes it; a segment or cover keeps its own sound once made. It owns only its table and is written only through the intermediary.
